#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007LL;
const long long BIG = (long long)1e18 + 1;

class Main {
public:
    void execute() {
        InputReader in(cin);
        Problem solver;
        solver.process(1, in, cout);
    }
};

class Problem {
private:
    long long binom[100][100];
    
    long long ways(long long base, int n1, int k1, int n2, int k2) {
        base = (base * binom[n1][k1]) % MOD;
        base = (base * binom[n2][k2]) % MOD;
        return base;
    }

public:
    void process(int testId, InputReader& in, ostream& out) {
        int N = in.nextInt();
        int limit = in.nextInt();
        int count50 = 0, count100 = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            int val = in.nextInt();
            if (val == 50) count50++;
            else count100++;
        }

        // Pascal's triangle
        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
            binom[i][0] = binom[i][i] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                binom[i][j] = (binom[i-1][j] + binom[i-1][j-1]) % MOD;
            }
        }

        long long minSteps[200][200][2];
        long long pathCount[200][200][2];
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 200; j++) {
                minSteps[i][j][0] = BIG;
                minSteps[i][j][1] = BIG;
                pathCount[i][j][0] = 0;
                pathCount[i][j][1] = 0;
            }
        }

        minSteps[0][0][0] = 0;
        pathCount[0][0][0] = 1;

        struct Node {
            int a, b, side;
            long long dist;
            Node(int a, int b, int side, long long dist) : a(a), b(b), side(side), dist(dist) {}
        };

        queue<Node> bfs;
        bfs.push(Node(0, 0, 0, 0));

        while (!bfs.empty()) {
            Node node = bfs.front();
            bfs.pop();
            int a = node.a;
            int b = node.b;
            int side = node.side;
            long long steps = minSteps[a][b][side];

            if (side == 0) {
                int left50 = count50 - a;
                int left100 = count100 - b;
                for (int take50 = 0; take50 <= left50; take50++) {
                    for (int take100 = 0; take100 <= left100; take100++) {
                        if (take50 == 0 && take100 == 0) continue;
                        int totalWeight = take50 * 50 + take100 * 100;
                        if (totalWeight > limit) break;
                        int na = a + take50;
                        int nb = b + take100;
                        int nextSide = side ^ 1;
                        if (minSteps[na][nb][nextSide] >= steps + 1) {
                            if (minSteps[na][nb][nextSide] > steps + 1) {
                                minSteps[na][nb][nextSide] = steps + 1;
                                bfs.push(Node(na, nb, nextSide, steps + 1));
                                pathCount[na][nb][nextSide] = (pathCount[na][nb][nextSide] + ways(pathCount[a][b][side], left50, take50, left100, take100)) % MOD;
                            } else {
                                pathCount[na][nb][nextSide] = (pathCount[na][nb][nextSide] + ways(pathCount[a][b][side], left50, take50, left100, take100)) % MOD;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                int left50 = a;
                int left100 = b;
                for (int take50 = 0; take50 <= left50; take50++) {
                    for (int take100 = 0; take100 <= left100; take100++) {
                        if (take50 == 0 && take100 == 0) continue;
                        int totalWeight = take50 * 50 + take100 * 100;
                        if (totalWeight > limit) break;
                        int na = a - take50;
                        int nb = b - take100;
                        int nextSide = side ^ 1;
                        if (minSteps[na][nb][nextSide] >= steps + 1) {
                            if (minSteps[na][nb][nextSide] > steps + 1) {
                                minSteps[na][nb][nextSide] = steps + 1;
                                bfs.push(Node(na, nb, nextSide, steps + 1));
                                pathCount[na][nb][nextSide] = (pathCount[na][nb][nextSide] + ways(pathCount[a][b][side], left50, take50, left100, take100)) % MOD;
                            } else {
                                pathCount[na][nb][nextSide] = (pathCount[na][nb][nextSide] + ways(pathCount[a][b][side], left50, take50, left100, take100)) % MOD;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (minSteps[count50][count100][1] == BIG) {
            out << -1 << endl;
        } else {
            out << minSteps[count50][count100][1] << endl;
        }
        out << pathCount[count50][count100][1] << endl;
    }
};

class InputReader {
private:
    istream& in;
    char buf[1024];
    int p, len;
    
public:
    InputReader(istream& stream) : in(stream), p(0), len(0) {}
    
    int nextByte() {
        if (p >= len) {
            p = 0;
            in.read(buf, sizeof(buf));
            len = in.gcount();
            if (len <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return (unsigned char)buf[p++];
    }
    
    int nextInt() {
        int c;
        while ((c = nextByte()) <= ' ') {}
        int val = 0;
        do {
            val = val * 10 + (c - '0');
        } while ((c = nextByte()) > ' ');
        return val;
    }
};

int main() {
    Main mainObj;
    mainObj.execute();
    return 0;
}
